full_prompt_en: A square symbolic mixed-media painting shows a pale-faced woman in a black cloak leaning forward beneath bare branches, set against a saturated red-orange field. Her long dark silhouette fills the center and lower part of the frame, widening toward the bottom like an irregular triangular cutout. The cloak and heavy hood are nearly black, with faint mottling and worn marks interrupting the solid mass. From the hood at the upper right, her small ivory face appears in strict profile, directed toward the right edge. Her features are finely drawn and calm, with a downturned gaze and a narrow pale nose standing out against the surrounding dark. The bright red background forms a tall arched shape around her, especially clear along the right side, while a narrow vertical strip of weathered gray-brown surface occupies the far right. Across the upper left and middle, a network of thin pale twigs crosses both the crimson ground and the dark hood. Several small charcoal birds perch among the branches; their simple bodies and pointed beaks echo the cool darkness of the cloak. One branch sweeps across the upper center, passing before the hood, and thinner stems rise from the lower-left edge. The distressed surface carries scratches, uneven pigment, and faint crackle-like marks, giving the red area the weight of worn plaster rather than smooth digital color. Light is shallow and even, making the face the brightest local point while leaving the cloak as a largely unmodeled shadow shape. The graphic contrast between large flat red and black areas is softened by the delicate branch tracery and the granular surface. No readable text appears. The overall composition is stark and inward, balancing one pale profile and fragile linear marks against a monumental dark silhouette and heated red ground.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形象征主义混合媒介绘画描绘一位穿黑斗篷、面色苍白的女子俯身于裸枝下，背景是饱和的红橙色域。她修长的深色剪影占据中央和下方，向底部扩展成不规则三角形剪纸般的形状。斗篷和厚重头罩近乎黑色，实心色块中有淡淡斑驳与磨损痕迹。头罩右上侧露出小小的象牙白侧脸，朝向画面右边。五官以细线描出，平静而目光微垂，狭窄的浅色鼻梁在周围暗色中清楚突出。鲜红背景在她周围形成高高的拱形，右侧尤其明显；最右边另有一条狭窄的风化灰棕表面。左上与中部，一张纤细浅色枝网同时越过深红背景和暗色头罩。几只小炭灰鸟停在枝上，简化的身形与尖喙呼应斗篷的冷暗色。一根枝条扫过上方中央，穿在头罩前面，较细枝茎则从左下缘升起。磨旧表面带擦痕、不均匀颜料和淡淡龟裂般的痕迹，让红色区域具有旧灰泥的重量，而非平滑数码色。光线浅而均匀，使面容成为局部最亮处，同时让斗篷保持几乎不塑造体积的影形。大面积平涂红与黑的图形反差被纤细枝线和颗粒表面柔化。画面没有可读文字。整体构图鲜明而内省，以一张浅色侧脸和脆弱线条，对照巨大的暗色剪影和灼热红色地面。
style_prompt_en: The image has a symbolic mixed-media finish built from monumental flat color areas and fragile linear tracery. Saturated vermilion and rust red press against near-black and charcoal, while a very small ivory accent becomes the visual hinge. Forms read first as cutout-like silhouettes; shallow fine detail gathers only where the focal edge meets the surrounding dark. Thin branching marks cross larger shapes and give the surface a wiry counter-rhythm. Uneven pigment, abrasion, faint scratches, and crackle-like texture keep the broad fields tactile and aged. Lighting is mostly even and shallow, with contrast created by adjacent color masses rather than cast shadows. A vertical mass set off-center meets an arching surround and a narrow differently toned border. The overall effect is austere, mysterious, and quietly tense.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有象征主义混合媒介完成面，由巨大的平面色域与脆弱纤细的线网构成。饱和朱红与铁锈红紧挨近黑和炭灰，极小的象牙白强调成为视觉支点。形体首先表现为剪纸般的剪影；浅而细的局部刻画只集中在焦点边缘与周围暗色相遇之处。细枝状笔迹横穿较大形体，给表面带来钢丝般的反向节奏。不均匀颜料、磨损、淡擦痕和龟裂般肌理使宽阔色面有触感且显陈旧。光线大体均匀而浅，反差由相邻色块形成，而非投影。偏离中央的竖向大块形体与拱形环绕面和一条异色窄边相接。整体效果克制、神秘而暗含紧张。
theme_en: A pale-faced woman in black beneath bare branches and dark birds
theme_zh: 裸枝与深色飞鸟下的黑衣苍白女子
name: Victoria Crowe
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
